# David Packer Describes A Calisthenics Skill Tree From Pull-Ups And Dips To Front Lever To Planche To Maltese And Rings Skills

David Packer describes a calisthenics skill tree that starts from pull-ups, dips and handstand push-ups, then goes to front lever and front lever pull-ups, then to planche, then to maltese, and then to rings skills like iron cross and victorian on rings. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- The fundamental pulling movement leads to front lever, then to front lever pull-ups, then to people of vic, then to vic on rings. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- The push side goes from planche to maltese. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Back lever is a pulling movement for the back side. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Maltese is a mix of push and pull. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- Iron cross is pulling yourself up but uses contradicting muscles like lats and front delts. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
